method: Exact upstream Git tree and ten canonical manifests, selected decisive supporting files; partial review clearly marked. No external execution.
macro_findings: Frozen changed-existing screening is 76/76 unique, not latest-source completion or admission.

212 physical manifests are not a canonical eligible denominator: three non-frontmattered nested phase references, six previously ungoverned July paths, nonidentical entra-agent-id exposures and nested first-class AKS skills need routing reconciliation.
Upstream 61fe changes shared plugin hooks and previously screened diagnostics/prepare packages; the ten package trees are unchanged from 1a63.
Hard authority failures: broad Graph identity grants, unapproved paid App Service creation, AKS provisioning, missing FastAPI object authorization.
Positive partial safeguards: read-only AKS Automatic assessment and explicit migration approvals.
No scanner, behavioral execution, pin change or governed companion.
